why: No problem in the key is about late payment or receivables. The truth does confirm the pattern: truth.customer_traits gives every customer a pay_habit, and customers 6 and 7 are in the 20-day group, customer 36 in the 45-day group (t408). Median days late run 0, 4, 10, 24 and 53 across the habit groups 0/3/8/20/45 (t410). The above-PO effect also holds within each habit group: above-PO invoices are more than 30 days late 62-89% of the time against 15-79% for matching ones, with medians of 37-87.5 days late against 0-50 (t411). The finding's $113,095/yr is a carrying cost at an assumed 8% rate, and the truth has no figure to check it against.
